meta.title: EduArena – Indoor football pitch
meta.description: Book the EduArena indoor football pitch online. Pick a day, time and duration – confirmation by email.

home.title:
Play anytime.
Rain doesn't matter.
home.subtitle: Covered pitch, brand-new artificial turf, LED floodlights and changing rooms. Pick a day and time, book in a minute.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need for a good game
home.f1d: New, joint-friendly surface, great for short studs.
home.f2d: Play in wind, rain or snow. Heated in winter.
home.f3d: Clean changing rooms, hot showers and lockers.
home.f4d: See free hours in real time and book straight from your phone.
home.how1d: See availability for the next 30 days.
home.how3d: You get a confirmation link. Pay on site.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.subtitle: The pitch, changing rooms and lounge. Tap a photo to enlarge it.

book.title: Book the pitch
book.subtitle: Pick a day, a start time and how long you want to play.
book.noSlots: No free hours left on this day. Try another day.
book.name: Full name
book.emailHint: We'll send the confirmation link here.
book.notePlaceholder: E.g. we're 10 players, we need bibs
book.payOnSite: Pay on site, cash or card.
book.successText: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Your booking is final only after you click it. We hold the pitch for you for {minutes} minutes.

errors.INVALID: Please check your details (name, email, phone).
errors.SLOT_TAKEN: Sorry, that time was just taken. Please pick another one.
errors.OUT_OF_RANGE: That date isn't available for booking.
errors.TOO_MANY_ACTIVE: You already have the maximum number of active bookings. Call us for more.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour or give us a call.
errors.CAPTCHA: Anti-bot check failed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.

confirm.CONFIRMED_text: See you on the pitch. We emailed you the details and a cancellation link.
confirm.EXPIRED_text: The booking wasn't confirmed in time and the slot was released. You can make a new booking.

cancel.title: Cancel booking
cancel.question: Are you sure you want to cancel this booking?
cancel.CANCELLED_text: The slot has been released. Hope to see you another time!
cancel.PAST: This booking is in the past and can't be cancelled.
cancel.NOT_FOUND: Invalid link or booking not found.
